answer: Here is one concrete wall: Frame maker brood frame warrant sealed by the wax hall. It works because each brood frame is a year of forage maps in the apiary ledger, so a farm must nail a hundred real frames by hand, and the horizon it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the cipher is that the farm's unit economics never work. The voyage is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
